decision_policy_review.finding: Current quorum counts specialist votes as independent and score dispersion alone cannot establish epistemic independence. Correlation-aware effective quorum remains a justified next design target, but requires an explicit evidence contract rather than inferring dependence from verdict similarity.
decision_policy_review.reason: No safe evidence field currently encodes specialist dependence/common-mode provenance. Adding such behavior without a validated contract would create false precision.

tests_workflows.note: No behavioral code change; no new test run required. Existing production behavior left untouched.
